This bean plot is very small, only about 0.08 hectares, so I will not spend much money on it. Beans fix their own nitrogen, so I do not waste fertilizer here — if I get any FISP coupon, I keep it for my maize plot. I will put some manure from our goats because it helps the soil hold water, and I will plant seed I saved from last year since improved bean seed is expensive and hard to find in Ntcheu. I will weed by hand with my wife; the plot is too small to need hired workers, and we have no way to irrigate — we depend on the rains.
